content: Flask uploads: send_from_directory() uses safe_join() and refuses client-crafted traversal paths. werkzeug.utils.secure_filename() returns an ASCII-only sanitized name safe for os.path.join. MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH caps request body bytes and raises 413 RequestEntityTooLarge before the view buffers the body. Source: flask.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/patterns/fileuploads/ and werkzeug.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/utils/.
